record: render verification — phase 18 (JOB SOA01-AB-1). Three A/B specimens rendered from the phase-17 programmes + the phase-18 variant scenes (each scene a parameterized variant of the settled phase-12 scene of record; the settled build is untouched). COMPARISON DESIGN, restated: the transcript A/B (t1-clone vs t2-clone) differs ONLY in transcript — same voice (the clone), same production chain, same bed, same scene system; the voice A/B (t1-clone vs t1-default) differs ONLY in voice — same transcript (V1, the phase-16 recommendation), same scene but for PLAN timings from its own takes.
procedure: CDP deterministic seek-capture of each scene at 30 fps (window.__seek per frame, private Chrome port per render) + ffmpeg mux with the programme WAV (libx264 crf 20, AAC 192 kb/s, faststart) — the phase-15 procedure. Capture incident, recorded: the first parallel captures died mid-run (two headless Chromes on a 2-core VM; the processes exited at frames 941/1500 and 919/1466 with their shells reporting success through a pipe). Both captures were RESUMED deterministically from the on-disk frame counts — renderAt(t) is a pure function of t, so a resumed capture is frame-identical to a continuous one; final frame counts verified exactly (1500 / 1466 / 1383) and the T1 seam frame (f0941, the first resumed frame) was viewed: continuous with its neighbours.
